name: Prismatic Sword
body:
School evocation [light]; Level inquisitor 4, paladin 3, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw will negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You summon a shimmering blade of scintillating colors. You are automatically proficient in this blade and it is treated as a +1 ghost touch longsword. When summoned and at the start of each round roll 1d8 to select one of the effects listed on the table below to the sword until the beginning of the next round.

Additionally, the sword’s enhancement bonus increases by 1 for every 5 caster levels you possess to a maximum of +5.

Any creature struck by the sword must succeed at a will saving throw or be dazed for one round. Once a creature succeeds at this saving throw it is immune to the dazing for 24 hours or until a critical hit is confirmed against them using the prismatic sword.

* Chosen by wielder when result is rolled.

d8

Color

Effect Gained

1 Red Flaming property 2 Orange Corrosive property 3 Yellow Shocking property 4 Green Bane property* 5 Blue Frost property 6 Indigo Vicious property 7 Violet Keen property 8 Two Colors Roll twice ignoring any result of ‘8’
